description: Source code for FFT-related spectral operations in PyTorch, including MKL and PocketFFT implementations, handling conjugate symmetry filling, and FFT plan creation.

classes.name: DftiDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor class for MKL FFT plans, managing initialization and execution.

methods.name: _plan_mkl_fft
methods.description: Creates an MKL FFT plan descriptor with specified parameters.

methods.name: _exec_fft
methods.description: Executes an FFT operation (forward or backward) using MKL, handling batching and dimension permutation.

methods.name: _sort_dims
methods.description: Sorts FFT dimensions based on input tensor strides for optimal performance.

methods.name: _fft_c2r_mkl
methods.description: Performs multi-dimensional complex-to-real inverse FFT using MKL.

methods.name: _fft_r2c_mkl
methods.description: Performs multi-dimensional real-to-complex FFT using MKL.

methods.name: _fft_c2c_mkl
methods.description: Performs multi-dimensional complex-to-complex FFT or IFFT using MKL.
